headline: Improving capacity utilisation of Jammu plant at the fore

highlights: Despite this, the absolute EBITDA grew ~35% YoY to ~₹70 crore with margins of 14.1% up 46 bps YoY.

PAT grew ~44% to ₹42.4 crore with 8.5% PAT margins up 79 bps YoY. • Long term prospects remain robust : For the quarter, the strong performance in the CDMO business was supported by client traction & continued business momentum while strength in Branded generics was due to expanding market reach, deeper penetration across existing markets and continued traction across the portfolio.
The plant’s capacity utilisation was ~5–10% in FY26 and it generated revenues of ~₹300 crore.

At the peak utilization of 55-60%, the Jammu facility can generate annualized revenues of ₹1,230-1,500 crore and an asset turnover ratio of approximately 2.5-3x. • The government’s Schedule M manufacturing norms which are in sync with the WHO standards in terms of quality, safety, hygiene and documentation, have become mandatory from 1st January 2026 (no further extensions).
